description: Source code for zip archive handling functions, including listing, testing, extracting, adding, and deleting files within zip archives, with support for encryption, compression, and specific archive formats like EPUB.

methods.name: xa_zip_ask
methods.description: Configures archive capabilities based on archive type and environment, including support for testing, extracting, adding, deleting, and compression features.

methods.name: xa_zip_password_str
methods.description: Generates a password string for archive operations, escaping bad characters if a password is set.

methods.name: xa_zip_parse_output
methods.description: Parses output lines from zip listing commands to extract file information, including size, permissions, encryption status, and timestamps.

methods.name: xa_zip_list
methods.description: Lists contents of a zip archive by executing the appropriate command and parsing its output.

methods.name: xa_zip_test
methods.description: Tests the integrity of a zip archive using the specified password.

methods.name: xa_zip_extract
methods.description: Extracts specified files from a zip archive, constructing and executing the appropriate command.

methods.name: xa_zip_add
methods.description: Adds files to a zip archive, with special handling for EPUB format and compression settings.

methods.name: xa_zip_delete
methods.description: Deletes specified files from a zip archive.
